issues.t: Engine stalls with a "steering power low" message
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving or at a light, the dash shows a message such as "engine stopped, steering power low," and steering becomes heavy. Some cars will not restart for a few minutes.
issues.why: Owners have filed many federal complaints about 2022 models shutting off without warning. No recall or single confirmed cause has been announced.
issues.next: If it happens, steer firmly to a safe spot and use the brakes. Have a dealer read the stored codes as soon as possible and file a complaint with NHTSA so the pattern is on record.

issues.t: Sudden loss of power or hybrid system warning
issues.sym: The car suddenly loses power, the screen may go dark, or a "Hybrid system malfunction" message appears, sometimes leaving the car stopped in traffic.
issues.why: Owners of 2024 and 2025 models report sudden power loss and shutdowns. No recall covers it, and the cause appears to vary from car to car.
issues.next: Get to a safe place, turn the car off and on again, and have it towed if warnings stay on. Ask the dealer to save the codes and file an NHTSA complaint.

issues.t: 12-volt battery dies or charging system warning
issues.sym: The car will not start or a "12-volt battery charging system malfunction" warning appears, sometimes telling you to stop in a safe place.
issues.why: Owners report 12-volt battery and charging faults, including batteries replaced more than once. A failing battery can also cause odd electrical behavior.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested. If the warning appears while driving, pull over safely and call for help rather than pushing on.

issues.t: "Engine Maintenance Required" from a failed coolant bypass valve
issues.sym: An "Engine Maintenance Required" message or check engine light, sometimes with poor heater output.
issues.why: The electric coolant bypass valve that controls coolant flow in the engine can fail. Toyota offered a customer support program for this valve on some models, but owners say the 2022 Corolla Cross was left out.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Ask a Toyota dealer whether any coverage applies to your VIN before paying for the valve.

issues.t: Milky oil and low oil pressure warning in cold weather
issues.sym: An "Oil Pressure Low" message, a check engine light, or milky oil on the dipstick or cap, usually after short trips in very cold weather.
issues.why: Moisture from the engine condenses in the oil on short cold trips and can freeze, dropping oil pressure. Toyota issued a bulletin for these 2.0L engines.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the oil and codes and follow the bulletin. Longer drives that fully warm the engine help keep moisture out.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy correctly (recall)
issues.sym: There is usually no warning. You may get a recall letter from Toyota.
issues.why: The dashboard may be missing a required tear line above the passenger airbag, which can keep the airbag from opening properly in a crash. Some cars needed a second inspection.
issues.next: Have a Toyota dealer check recalls 23V-384 and 23V-864 with your VIN. The repair is free.

issues.t: Driver airbag may be disabled by a weak steering wire weld (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: A weld in the spiral cable inside the steering column can separate and cut the connection to the driver airbag. Some cars repaired the first time needed the fix redone.
issues.next: Have a Toyota dealer check recalls 23V-480 and 25V-040. The repair is free.

issues.t: Brake assist may drop out while turning (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels hard and the car takes longer to stop, especially while turning.
issues.why: A software error in the brake control computer can cause a brief loss of power brake assist.
issues.next: Have a Toyota dealer check recall 24V-708 and update the software for free. Leave extra following distance until it is done.

issues.t: Pedestrian warning sound too quiet in reverse (recall)
issues.sym: People outside the car may not hear it backing up at low speed.
issues.why: The external warning sound that quiet hybrids make for pedestrians may not be loud enough when reversing.
issues.next: Have a Toyota dealer check recall 26V-203 and update the software for free. Take extra care in parking lots.

issues.t: Sunroof glass shatters while driving
issues.sym: A loud bang and broken glass from the sunroof while driving, often at highway speed and with no obvious impact.
issues.why: Owners of 2023 through 2025 models have reported the sunroof glass shattering on its own.
issues.next: Pull over safely and cover the opening. Report it to NHTSA and Toyota and check whether warranty or insurance glass coverage applies.

issues.t: Brakes apply unexpectedly or collision warnings with nothing ahead
issues.sym: The car brakes hard on its own, a red brake warning flashes, or lane-keeping and cruise control behave oddly with no obstacle in sight.
issues.why: Owners report false activations from the pre-collision and driver-assist systems. Dirty sensors, sensor aim or software can play a part.
issues.next: Keep the windshield camera area and front grille sensor clean. Have a dealer check sensor aim and software, and report repeated events to NHTSA.

issues.t: Power steering assist cuts out briefly
issues.sym: The steering suddenly becomes heavy for a moment or a power steering or "System Failure" warning appears.
issues.why: Owners report brief losses of electric power steering assist. No recall has been announced.
issues.next: Slow down and grip the wheel firmly. Have the dealer read the steering system codes even if it went away, and file an NHTSA complaint.

issues.t: CVT slipping or hesitation
issues.sym: The car hesitates, lurches, slips on hills or loses power when accelerating.
issues.why: Owners report CVT slipping and hesitation, including failures at low mileage. No pattern-wide cause has been confirmed.
issues.next: Have the car scanned for transmission codes while it is under warranty, and note when it happens so the dealer can reproduce it.

issues.t: Shadows from the headlights at night
issues.sym: A dark shadow across the top of the low beam pattern, or headlights that seem not to light the road properly.
issues.why: Owners report a shadow in the beam pattern that dealer adjustments did not fix.
issues.next: Have the headlight aim checked and report it to NHTSA if it remains.

issues.t: Dim or hard-to-see tail and brake lights
issues.sym: Drivers behind you say the tail or brake lights are hard to see at night.
issues.why: Owners report the rear lights look dim or small, and some brake lights do not fully light up.
issues.next: Have someone check that every brake and tail light segment lights up. A dealer can replace a lamp that is not fully lit.

issues.t: Key fob not detected
issues.sym: A "key not detected" message, the car will not start, or the alarm keeps going off even with the key inside.
issues.why: The smart key system loses the fob signal, often from a weak fob battery or radio interference.
issues.next: Replace the fob battery first. To start, hold the fob against the start button. If it continues, have a dealer check the key system.

issues.t: Screen pop-ups and repeated PIN prompts
issues.sym: Pop-up messages or a "enter PIN" prompt keep appearing on the touchscreen and cover the map while driving.
issues.why: The connected-services software keeps asking for account setup or showing subscription offers.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to update the head unit software and complete or turn off the connected-services setup.

issues.t: Power liftgate stops opening after a software update
issues.sym: The power rear hatch will not open with the button or key after a dealer software update.
issues.why: Owners report the liftgate stopping working shortly after a recall software update was applied.
issues.next: Return to the dealer that did the update. It should be fixed at no cost.

issues.t: Gauge display hard to read in sunlight
issues.sym: When the sun shines in, the instrument display washes out and is hard to read.
issues.why: Owners report glare on the digital gauge display.
issues.next: Try raising display brightness. There is no known repair.

issues.t: Touchscreen glitches in subzero cold
issues.sym: The touchscreen and connected functions act up or freeze on very cold mornings.
issues.why: Owners report the infotainment computer misbehaving at subzero temperatures until the cabin warms up.
issues.next: Let the cabin warm up. If it keeps happening, ask a dealer for a software update.
